notes.title: Demo-V0.2.0 is live!!!
notes.content: [h3][b]🔧 New Features:[/b][/h3][p]1. Added a new protagonist model.[/p][p]2. Reworked the combat flow and introduced some deck-building (DBG) elements.[/p][p]3. Added new enemy skill configurations to increase combat difficulty.[/p][p]4. Added a [b]player healing skill[/b], and removed the cooldown time for player skills — you can now use your skills [b]limitlessly[/b]!!![/p][p]5. Status effect system is now live.[/p][p]6. A slot machine feature has been added to the idle mode for enhanced variety.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]✨ Experience Improvements:[/b][/h3][p]1. A new screen visual effect has been added — you can disable it in the settings if you prefer the classic look.[/p][p]2. Improved some UI visuals and presentation.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p]1. Fixed some minor bugs (but there might be new ones lurking — stay tuned!).[/p][p] [/p][p]========================== [b]Combat System Update[/b] ==========================[/p][p]Low-value dice are no longer useless! You can now place them into the [b]buffer zone[/b] to help reduce its total points. Enemies will now [b]scale their attacks[/b] based on your buffer zone's point total — so using lower dice strategically can [b]mitigate incoming damage[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/891809bf6b1e76363b315e8e32d8e55b4d37a581.gif"][/img][/p][p]On the flip side, [b]high-value dice[/b] now have even more impact. If your dice points [b]exceed the enemy's buffer requirement[/b], your attack will be [b]amplified[/b], dealing bonus damage! So try to maximize your dice values using any skills or abilities you have![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/3733cc0bb09d13afe167723a58e3d5d0ad87081c.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]========================== [b]Idle Gameplay Update[/b] ==========================[/p][p]We've added our [b]main character[/b] to the main scene! Yes, finally — we have a protagonist! 😎[/p][p]Expect to see all sorts of cool and fun new features built around this stylish figure in the near future![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/39b2c35b8d366405a316ce148d18d1d11ec62d8f.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've also reworked the idle system in the base:[/p][p]You now have to [b]defeat enemies within a time limit[/b] to break through and increase your [b]attack power in outpost battles[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/8c6a26d39fa1be639da466b7f0587e0b93530242.gif"][/img][/p][p]While fighting enemies, you'll now see a new item drop: [b]Happiness Bonds[/b].[/p][p]These can be used to [b]manually trigger the slot machine[/b] on screen — granting you a [b]huge money reward[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/c739d155cd4b54d42fd6606182b06026365bb1fd.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/44ba03795442ce49f60e53271e2354e622238779.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎲 New Demo for Dicey Hacker 1999 Coming This July! 🎉
notes.content:
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/c67ee55890f60c7ba0d30de52fa5da049099dbd0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/a1de1dba1f759cf734df12fca08d1f2412c0543b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/650ad057dfa481f8a4cb7b1b7fec2f5d5d2a9fae.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Hackers, we're back![/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that the next [b]demo build[/b] of [i]Dicey Hacker 1999[/i] is dropping in [b]July[/b] — and it's packed with exciting new content and improvements:[/p][p]✨ [b]All-new screen effects[/b] – More cyber, more retro, and a huge visual upgrade!
⚔️ [b]New combat flow and gameplay mechanics[/b] – Faster, sharper, and more strategic than ever before.
🎉 [b]We finally have a main character![/b] – That’s right! For the first time, you’ll meet our [b]mascot protagonist[/b], who’ll join you on your journey through the data maze.[/p][p]📝 [b]Don’t forget to add us to your wishlist[/b] so you won’t miss the release and future updates![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DiceyHacker1999 Demo Version Now Publicly Released
notes.content: [p]"In this demo release, you can experience partial idle mechanics and dice-driven combat gameplay. I'll keep updating this trial version with more content and features~[/p][p][/p][p]While many iterations and enhancements are planned, I strongly hope to gather player feedback and suggestions as early as possible. I firmly believe a great game is co-created by developers and players! If you're interested in [i]DiceyHacker1999[/i], join my Discord for early-stage discussions and add the game to your Wishlist!"[/p]
